concerns.text: The success criteria (SC-001) define significance only via a paired‑test p‑value < 0.05 and ΔR² ≥ 0.02, but the original idea explicitly requires a cross‑validated Pearson R ≥ 0.80 and a mean absolute error ≤ 20 % of the experimental TOF range. By omitting these performance thresholds the spec silently redefines the research question’s success condition, risking a drift away from the idea’s stated scientific goal.

FR‑008 ties model‑improvement significance to the same ΔR² ≥ 0.02 rule, further cementing the drift introduced in SC‑001. The idea never stipulated a ΔR² threshold; it focused on absolute Pearson R and MAE targets. This over‑constrains the evaluation and may reject models that meet the idea’s criteria but fall short of the arbitrary ΔR² cut‑off.
